title: Bounded progress
contract: A continuously pending request is served within two enabled scheduler ticks under the stipulated bounded fairness rule.
scope: Three ticks, service choice at each tick; continuously pending until service; admitted traces contain service within first two ticks.
assumptions: Exactly the abstract finite model and input domain described in scope; no claim about LLMLang implementation or unbounded executions.

obligations.claim: Every admitted trace completes by tick two; candidate must actually process service action.

variants.description: Ignore the first two service opportunities.
